title: Recording: Magneto And Titanium Man, Rock Show by Wings | 1975
content:
Sea-Saint Recording Studio, New Orleans
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Alan O’Duffy, Ken Laxton, Roberta Grace

Wings continued working on the Venus And Mars songs ‘Magneto And Titanium Man’ and ‘Rock Show’ on 28 January 1975.

The backing tracks for both had been recorded the previous day. The new overdubs included Paul McCartney doubling Linda McCartney’s clavinet intro on ‘Magneto And Titanium Man’, and addition drums and percussion on ‘Rock Show’. Allen Toussaint also added Fender Rhodes to the song, and Paul overdubbed a Mellotron part.
